thread:
Anna (eng-platform): quick gut-check: should micro-bursts (10s spikes) trigger autofallback at all?
Raj (eng-runtime): no on default. micro-bursts can be noise. prefer min-duration + sample-first policy.
Maya (product): product asks that customer-visible degradations are minimized. if we ignore micro-bursts, customers might see glitchy behavior.
Liu (eng-sre): compromise: require trigger sustain >30s OR two consecutive windows with same signal. add oscillation guard.
Raj (eng-runtime): proposed rule: detect >X% for 60s window, soft-sample 20% immediately, require sustained 3m for hard-degrade.
Anna (eng-platform): can we show "why not degraded" in the UI when we skip a micro-burst? helps ops understand non-action.
Raj (eng-runtime): yes. emit a skipped_decision event with reason SKIPPED_MICROBURST and snapshot.
Maya (product): also request a compact timeline in the console showing skipped events vs enacted ones.
Liu (eng-sre): telemetry: sample 100% of skipped_decision for first 2m of any new rule to validate.
MiniBot: quick sim: workload=5k reqs with 12s spikes -> engagements: soft_samples only, hard_degrades=0, expected_fp=0.4%.
Anna (eng-platform): ok, plan: (1) Raj add SKIPPED_MICROBURST emit, (2) Zoe (devex) add skipped timeline view, (3) Liu estimate short-term trace retention. I'll add tickets.
Maya (product): thanks all.
